name: Levoit Core 300S
summary: Levoit's best-known small purifier, with the smallest footprint here at 8.7 in across. Three independent reviews agree it's a solid small-room unit, but it's rated for about 220 sq ft and gets noisy when pushed, so it's undersized for most studios.
idealFor: A sleeping alcove or a studio under about 220 sq ft
Shelves and nightstands: 5.95 lb and 8.7 in across
pros: Smallest and lightest unit here: 8.7 × 8.7 in, 5.95 lb
Three independent reviews over months of use, including 1,400 hours (Trusted Reviews)
App, auto mode and a range of filter types
cons: Undersized for most studios: rated 141 cfm, measured 126 cfm on smoke
Only the lowest speed stays under 45 dBA at 3 ft (HouseFresh)
Filters last 6–8 months, so you'll buy about two a year

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it works well in small rooms, and HouseFresh's measured CADR is close to Levoit's rating. Levoit publishes dimensions, weight, CADR, noise, a 2-year warranty and a US address. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list and there are no CPSC recalls for the brand; it loses safety points only because materials aren't declared.

sources.title: HouseFresh: Levoit Core 300S review
sources.note: Danny Ashton, bought the unit. CADR 126 smoke / 134 dust / 154 pollen; test room cleared in 45 min at top speed; 38.9, 45.7 and 54.5 dB at 3 ft on speeds 1–3; about $55 a year in filters

sources.title: Trusted Reviews: Levoit Core 300S review
sources.note: Main purifier for five months, about 1,400 hours. Smoke test PM2.5 to 'good' in 14 min; about twice as slow as the most powerful unit tested; Wi-Fi dropouts fixed by a firmware update

sources.title: Ideal Home: Levoit Core 300S review
sources.note: Amy Lockwood, Jan 2024, home tests with smoke, deodorant, cooking and dust. Auto mode missed dust; top speed too loud for overnight; compact and easy to use

sources.title: CPSC Recalls API, title search 'Levoit' since 2021-10-27
sources.note: No recalls returned; none with Levoit as importer or VeSync as manufacturer either
